turns.instruction: Analyze the single-slope 15 m truss using the explicit attachment. The lower chord is horizontal; the upper height increases from 1.5 to 3 m. Upper-chord E=210000 MPa; lower-chord and web E=200000 MPa. Downward loads of 8, 12 and 6 kN act at upper nodes x=3,9,15 m. Report Ux/Uz at U5, the upper x=15 m node; Fx/Fz at left support L0; and axial N in first lower-chord member BC1 (L0 to L1). Include signed direction, units, D case and turn 1.

Move only upper node U5 at x=15 m from z=3 to z=3.3 m. Keep every other node, connection, load ID, force vector and material role unchanged. Update member geometry from its endpoints and reanalyze. Report U5 Ux/Uz, L0 reactions Fx/Fz and BC1 axial N with location, direction, units, D case and turn 2.
